main_text.p: משלים שכל מלה שבמשל ההוא יש בה עניין ומהם מה שיהיה כל המשל סגיד על כל הענין ההוא הנמשל ויבאו במשל ההוא דברים רבים מאד אין כל מלה מהם מוספת ענין בעניין ההוא הנמשל אבל הם ליפול , vel (ut in comment. legit Schem Tob) ליפות המשל וסור הדברים בו (Quæ verba Doctiss. D. Johannes Buxtorfius, Magni Buxtorfij filius, paternæ eruditionis ex asse hæres, ad hunc modum transtulit. Parabolæ autem propheticæ duplicis sunt generis. In quibusdam enim singulæ voces rem aliquam peculiarem denotant: aliæ vero sunt, ubi tota Parabola rem significatam totam exhibet, in quibus quidem multa habentur verba, sed non singula rei significatæ aliquid addunt; verum inserviunt tantum ad elegantiam vel (si Hebr. editionem quæ mihi ad manus est sequamur, diversa enim est lectio) ut fluat parabola atque in ipsa rerum ordo servetur. Plura in hanc sententiam subjungit Moses ille Maimonides, quibus varijs rationibus distinctionem suam stabilit: unde concludere liceat, ipsis Judæis assentientibus in Ezech. structura sufficere, si tota sententia ostendatur, quamvis partes singulæ peculiaria membra non respiciant. Atque hæc de templo Ezechielis sufficiant; ad reducum Israelitarum sacrum ædificium redeamus. Hoc insignem mutationem subijt tempore Herodis: hic enim si non exstruxisse, saltem admodum immutasse Iudæorum templum legitur. Josephus præclarum hoc Herodis factum accuratè descripsit ἐχαμολ. λόγ. ιε. κιφ.

page.notes: The Hebrew lines at the top are printed in Hebrew letters and are transcribed as the scan shows them; the first line and the final Hebrew phrase before "Quæ verba" are the least certain readings. The Greek at the end ("ἐχαμολ. λόγ. ιε." and "κιφ.") is only partly legible: the first word and the reference may be misread. Verse-like Hebrew lines are run together in one paragraph because the printed block is a quotation within the continuous text. Line-end hyphens are kept as printed ("Pa-rabolæ", "Parabo-la", "tem-plo", "tem-pore"). The page continues from the previous page, so the paragraph is marked cont="true".
